name: Snapmaker U1 active toolhead
source: EdgeSlicer estimate, no CAD or measurement available. Only the active (docked-in) head is described: the U1 parks the other three heads at the back, out of the print area. Nozzle: a generic brass nozzle outline (about 1 mm tip land, cone of roughly 40 degrees half-angle). Sock and head body: round-number boxes chosen to be conservative. Gantry rod height 26 mm and distance 41.2 mm are Snapmaker's extruder_clearance_height_to_rod / dist_to_rod from the U1 machine profile; which side of the nozzle the rod is on is not known, so the gantry box spans both sides. Measure before relying on any of it.
